title.value: Expressiveness and Learning of Hidden Quantum Markov Models
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the paper's focus on the expressiveness of Hidden Quantum Markov Models (HQMMs) and developing learning algorithms for them.
title.quote: Expressiveness and Learning of Hidden Quantum Markov Models

analysis.description: The paper investigates the expressiveness of Hidden Quantum Markov Models (HQMMs), showing they form a special subclass of Observable Operator Models (OOMs) that do not suffer from the negative probability problem. It introduces a novel retraction-based learning algorithm using constrained gradient descent on the Stiefel manifold, allowing faster and more scalable learning of HQMMs. The theoretical contributions include characterizing HQMMs and their relationship with OOMs. Experimentally, it demonstrates superior performance over previous learning methods on synthetic and real datasets.
